title: P1: remediate pre-existing dependency vulnerabilities
body: A complete diagnostic audit using DEVAI PR #413 found 37 advisories: 5 critical, 15 high, 13 moderate, 4 low. The exact pre-upgrade manifests at 57ca183f have identical advisory IDs and severities; no advisory was introduced by DEVAI adoption. Evidence: work/rounds/R-0036/reports/remediation-599161f9/dependency-audit-comparison.json and evidence-manifest.json. Owner: Architect for remediation choices; Engineer for a separate product PR. Keep sensor thresholds unchanged; rerun the complete audit after remediation. The unpublished-provider diagnostic is not an official scorecard reading.
